basics.name: Marcelo Max Acosta Archondo
basics.label: Backend Developer, Gameplay programmer
basics.summary: I have 5+ years of comprehensive experience as a .NET Developer coupled with expertise in handling SQLServer, MySQL and Informix databases. Additionally, I have a background using Apache Kafka as a distributed event system to communicate between microservices, Elastic Search to provide support to our clients, Amazon Web Services to provide support in workflows. While focused mainly on backend development, I have an interest in graphics programming areas like procedural generation algorithms. I am enthusiastic to join new team environments and have an ongoing interest for self-directed learning in different areas.

work.name: VIRIDIAN Business Ltd.
work.summary: Viridian is a software company focused on developing online banking systems aimed to bank's end users. I started working with basic CRUD restAPI interfaces, as the project grow and the solution finally deployed, i was tasked with some bank workflows suchs as bank transfers, QR transfers, batchpayemnts and onboarding processes from the early desgin to the actual implementation of those
highlights: Responsible of onboarding module which allows new clients to join the platform, which handled between 3000 and 5000 monthly new customers
In charge of batchpayments module which usually handle payroll payments from companies to employees
Optimized statistics data recollection for monthly reports
Developed in demand automatic reports for bank client's accounts and internal reports
Design and implemented procedures for "in office" terminals used by customers directly
Design and implemented procedures for mobile wallet app
Monitored and fixed critical bugs and issues
Developed our "dummy" bank for internal development purposes

The game focused on teaching child rights through several minigames. I joined mid development and  was tasked from developing gameplay mechanics and UI workflows to some minigames
highlights: Developed several minigames teaching child rights

work.name: HCTR - High Control Games: El guardian

highlights: Worked on input handling thorugh the headset's accelerometer

work.name: HCTR - High Control Games: Jukucuentos
work.summary: "Jukucuentos" is a mobile video game designed to teach children Aymara language, aimed to younger audiences. I worked on gameplay mechanics integrating a third party custom speech recognition library to recognize Aymara words to perform simple in game actions like player movement
highlights: Developed in game mechanics to be used by speech recognition input
